S-SNARC.NAME: SNARC
S-SNARC.core-purpose: Salience-gated memory that captures tool use and conversation, scores Surprise/Novelty/Arousal/Reward/Conflict, stores salient observations in SQLite, consolidates patterns, injects relevant memories, and exposes MCP retrieval tools.

key-surfaces.surface-1: src/memory.ts orchestrates capture, scoring, storage, consolidation, search, context, stats, and session briefing.
key-surfaces.surface-2: src/snarc.ts implements heuristic SNARC salience scoring.
key-surfaces.surface-3: src/db.ts defines project-scoped SQLite schema and prepared statements.
key-surfaces.surface-4: src/server.ts exposes MCP tools: snarc_search, snarc_context, snarc_patterns, snarc_stats.
key-surfaces.surface-5: hooks/handlers/* maps Claude hook events to memory capture/injection/dream cycles.

strengths.strength-1: Complements Reasonix memory with selective, provenance-labeled, project-scoped memory.
strengths.strength-2: Heuristic scoring is fast enough for tool hooks and does not require live model calls.
strengths.strength-3: MCP retrieval tools map cleanly into Reasonix MCP or native tool registry.

integration-obligations.obligation-1: Use Reasonix hook and loop events as native SNARC input instead of Claude-only hook JSON.
integration-obligations.obligation-2: Add a Reasonix compaction event adapter so SNARC can capture conversation before or during compaction.
integration-obligations.obligation-3: Route deep dream through Reasonix model client or make it optional; do not depend on Claude CLI in MAGRA core.
integration-obligations.obligation-4: Expose SNARC stats/search/patterns in dashboard and MCP surfaces with provenance labels.

risks.risk-1: Current `.engram` naming should be migrated or aliased to MAGRA/SNARC without breaking portability.
risks.risk-2: Auto-promoted identity facts can be wrong; MAGRA needs review controls and confidence decay visibility.
risks.risk-3: Conversation capture must respect privacy and redaction settings.
